title: VS Code Keyboard Shortcuts
description: Essential VS Code shortcuts for navigation, editing, refactoring, and terminal — boost your productivity.

entries.label: Command Palette
entries.description: Open the command palette — the gateway to every VS Code feature

entries.label: Quick Open File
entries.description: Fuzzy search and open any file in the project by name

entries.label: Go to Symbol
entries.description: Jump to a function, class, or variable in the current file

entries.label: Go to Definition
entries.description: Jump to where a function or variable is defined

entries.label: Find All References
entries.description: Show all usages of a symbol across the entire project

entries.label: Multi-Cursor (Select Next)
entries.description: Select the next occurrence of the current selection — repeat for more

entries.label: Multi-Cursor (All Occurrences)
entries.description: Select ALL occurrences of the current selection at once

entries.label: Move Line Up/Down
entries.description: Move the current line (or selection) up or down

entries.label: Rename Symbol
entries.description: Rename a variable/function across all files (LSP-powered refactor)

entries.label: Fold/Unfold Code
entries.description: Collapse or expand code blocks for better overview
